locator: Dark Gifts of Dalaran mechanics section
faithful_paraphrase: Starting on turn 3, the player can spend 3 Gold to Discover one of three minions carrying a Dark Gift; the button is limited to once per turn and three uses per game.

The developer explainer defines a turn-by-turn Tavern Tier schedule and additional exclusions for Battlecry/Choose One, Magnetic, when-sold, hand-only, and selected individual minions; from turn 6 one offer matches the player's most common minion type.

locator: Dark Gift Pool and Gift Restrictions sections
faithful_paraphrase: The original 43 gifts use min/max turn windows and compatibility restrictions tied to minion text, prior gift use, lobby tribes, and special conditions; Tras'tath uses a separate defined subset.
Patch 36.2.2 changed multiple gift turn windows, values, and compatibility rules, removed Toxicity from Tras'tath's pool, banned Boom-in-a-Box from Dark Gifts, and fixed invalid Transcendence offers.
The later 36.4 notes contain Battlegrounds fixes but no new Dark Gift rule or balance changes, so 36.2.2 remains the latest inspected Dark Gift rules overlay as of 2026-08-28.
Several players answer that a minion received through Dark Gifts is drawn from the normal shared minion pool, but no cited official rule is provided.
The official announcement explains the offer and usage rules but does not state whether the selected minion consumes a finite Tavern copy.
The inspected developer explainer specifies offer eligibility in detail but does not explicitly resolve shared-copy depletion.
